note: Well-treed campground in Peter Lougheed PP near Lower Kananaskis Lake, three loops, most sites suited to RVs and tents; on-site manager and caretaker. Hand-pump water is not safe to drink; taps run about early June to early September, weather permitting. No on-site dump (Canyon and Boulton Creek have one). --Claude
